meta.purpose: Demo sample dataset for the Outgrid Plan Agent (Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon). Expanded at Fabrice's direction Oct 27, 2026: 5 top nomad countries with cities, so judges have enough material to evaluate the Planner/Verifier on varied records.
meta.source: Outgrid public API (https://outgrid.io/api/agent) — pre-existing Outgrid data, exported as a standalone snapshot for the hackathon repo. The full 137-destination dataset predates the hackathon and is not part of the judged build.
meta.selection_basis: Nomad Score + city-record depth + regional spread (Americas x2, Europe x1, Asia x2). Bacalar stays the demo hero (founder's current base).
meta.usage: Planner may ground claims ONLY in these records; every factual item needs a source_ref to the exact record id + field. Visa/safety fields follow the records' verification_note/verified_facts; anything absent is unverifiable, never invented.

countries.name: Mexico
countries.visa: Easy residency options: Temporary Resident Visa
countries.tax_notes: Foreign nationals on temporary residence who do not become tax residents pay 0% on foreign income. To avoid Mexican tax residency, spend fewer than 183 days/year OR ensure your primary economic interests remain outside Mexico.
countries.best_for: US-based nomads, Spanish learners, those wanting Americas base
pros: Same time zones as US (great for US clients)
No tax on foreign income if non-resident
cons: U.S. travel advisory Level 2: exercise increased caution

countries.name: Thailand
countries.visa: Dedicated digital nomad visa: LTR Visa (Long-Term Resident)
countries.tax_notes: LTR visa holders: 17% flat tax on Thai-sourced income (special rate). Foreign income remitted to Thailand: 0% if earned in a prior tax year. Effectively 0% for most nomads.
countries.best_for: Experienced nomads, those with higher income, anyone wanting SE Asia base
pros: 0% tax on foreign income for LTR holders
Incredible food and quality of life

entry_requirements.note: All passengers must complete the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) online before arrival; Thai visas are issued through the official Thai e-Visa website.

countries.name: Portugal
countries.visa: Dedicated digital nomad visa: D8 Digital Nomad Visa
countries.tax_notes: NHR (Non-Habitual Resident) regime: 20% flat tax on Portuguese income + 0% on most foreign income for 10 years. Crypto held >1 year is tax-free. NHR 2.0 launched 2024 as IFICI at 20%.
countries.best_for: EU residency seekers, families, US/UK nomads wanting EU base

countries.name: Colombia
countries.visa: Dedicated digital nomad visa: Digital Nomad Visa (V Nomada)
countries.tax_notes: Nomad visa holders are NOT considered Colombian tax residents (requires 183 days + economic ties). 0% on foreign income. If you become a tax resident, rates up to 39% apply.
countries.best_for: Budget nomads, Spanish learners, Americas-based nomads
cons: U.S. travel advisory Level 3: reconsider travel

countries.name: Indonesia (Bali)
countries.visa: Easy residency options: Second Home Visa
countries.tax_notes: Indonesia only taxes income from Indonesian sources. Foreign income (your clients abroad) is 0% if you do not become a tax resident (which requires being there 183+ days AND registering). Most nomads on social visas avoid this.
countries.best_for: Lifestyle nomads, creatives, surfers, those wanting SE Asia vibes
cons: U.S. travel advisory Level 2: exercise increased caution
